summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs so `python3 main.py` prints `Hello, world!`: the import in `main.py` pointed to a nonexistent `greetings` module instead of `greeter`, and `def greet(name)` in `greeter.py` was missing its colon. I confirmed the fix by running the program, which print
